about: Move the existing selected-square status below the styled board, use AD-2 for the existing composition, and report rendered evidence truthfully.

request.prompt: This repository contains a local 8×8 board with square selection, an existing polite status above the board, and Reset. Move that existing status immediately below the board and use it as the selected-square summary; keep its selected-coordinate announcement and Reset’s ‘Choose a square’ prompt. R-1: Use the accepted board direction recorded in product documentation to shape the summary and plan a rendered browser check at narrow and wide widths in light and dark themes. R-2: Preserve all 64 selectable local squares, the existing selection announcement and Reset behavior, and the existing node:test suite. Stay local, with no dependencies or external service.

work_item.title: Move the existing selection status below the board
work_item.context: Use the existing polite status as the selected-square summary immediately below the board. Preserve its coordinate announcement, Reset prompt, board state behavior, and test coverage. Do not create a second status or add a state helper.

step-plan.summary: One bounded step moves the existing selected-square status below the board, preserves its state behavior, and follows the accepted AD-2.

criteria.text: Move the existing polite status below the board as the selected-square summary. It reports the selected coordinate and Reset restores 'Choose a square'. Confirm with TC-SUMMARY. Serves R-1.

Preserve all 64 existing selectable squares, selection and Reset behavior, and the existing node:test suite. Confirm the rendered control count with TC-LAYOUT and functional state with TC-BOARD. Serves R-2.

Use accepted AD-2 at docs/shiploop/architecture.md, sections Summary composition, Appearance and tokens, and Theme and observations. The summary uses --surface #fffdf8 and --ink #19302e. Move the existing polite status into the summary position directly below the board in normal flow, with a 1rem gap and maximum width 32rem; preserve the centered 44rem content column and square board up to 32rem. Keep the current identity and theme from AD-2 without broader redesign. For TC-LAYOUT, observe summary placement/width, board and equal-cell geometry, overflow, visible focus, and select/reset at 390x844 and 1440x1000 in light/dark. If browser evidence is not captured, keep it explicitly pending rather than using node tests as visual proof. Serves R-1.

steps.task: Move the existing status below the board while preserving behavior and the accepted AD-2 composition (C1, C2, C3).

step-plan.check_na: The plain JavaScript fixture has no configured lint, type-check, or build command.

expectations.statement: The existing board state module supports square selection and reset.
The existing board module renders local square controls.
The existing polite status is above the board and can be moved without adding a second status.
The existing board styles can retain the saved identity while applying the summary placement.
The accepted board direction is available to the implementation step.
The existing board state suite is present.
The local rendered browser helper is present for layout observation.

test-spec.summary: TC-LAYOUT specifies the supplied browser procedure for summary placement and measure, board/cell geometry, overflow, visible focus, selection/reset, and all 64 controls at 390x844 and 1440x1000 in both themes. TC-BOARD and TC-SUMMARY retain the existing node --test state assertions for selection, valid coordinates, and Reset. This specification records a rendered procedure; the browser route must be probed before relying on the command, and TC-LAYOUT remains pending until a later evidence record captures its output.

test_cases.oracle: Use the accepted AD-2 record in docs/shiploop/architecture.md for the selected summary composition. Probe PLAYWRIGHT_NODE_PATH and BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_PATH, then run node scripts/check-board-browser.cjs --light-page '#f4f1e9' --dark-page '#17201f' --square-a '#e7dcc5' --square-b '#34746b' --board-max 32rem --focus-color '#214c46' --dark-focus-color '#f3c15b' --dark-class theme-dark --summary-below --summary-max 32rem --summary-gap 1rem. At 390x844 and 1440x1000 in light and dark themes, observe summary placement below the board, its 32rem cap and 1rem gap, square board/equal cells, no horizontal overflow, visible focus, and all 64 rendered square buttons.
test_cases.red: The board or cells are not square, overflow appears, the existing summary is misplaced or exceeds its saved width/gap, focus is not visible, or a square button is absent.
test_cases.green: The browser observations pass at both viewport sizes and themes; retain the per-viewport/theme TC-LAYOUT output lines.

test_cases.oracle: Run node --test test/board-state.test.mjs for existing selection, coordinate-validation, and Reset state checks. TC-LAYOUT separately observes the 64 rendered square buttons; Node state assertions do not establish their appearance.
test_cases.red: Selection, coordinate validation, or Reset state behavior regresses.
test_cases.green: The existing node state checks pass and the browser observation confirms all 64 controls remain present.

test_cases.oracle: Run node --test test/board-state.test.mjs to assert the initial Choose a square prompt, a selected coordinate such as Selected: a1, and Reset restoring Choose a square. TC-LAYOUT also checks the visible status after browser selection and Reset.
test_cases.red: The existing status text or Reset behavior fails, or the rendered status does not announce selection and reset.
test_cases.green: The node state checks and the browser-observed polite status interaction pass.
